conventions.root: Every ship part and anchor descends from the root; move, rotate or scale the root only.
conventions.anchors: Local +X is the effect axis (drive exhaust aft; gun line of fire); +Z as near hull-dorsal as that allows.
conventions.turrets: Rotate a Turret <i> pivot about its local Z to train; rest pose is the slot angle (plus jam_deg when jammed). Rotate Turret <i> elevation about its local Y to elevate (negative lifts the muzzles); slide Turret <i> recoil <k> along its local -X to recoil a barrel. Anchor turret <i> barrel <k> muzzle: +X along the line of fire. A seized mount (jammed or wrecked) or a stripped one carries nothing and has no muzzle.
conventions.sparks: Scar <id> spark anchor: +X along the spray; emit only where sparking is true.
conventions.wear: Base wear: group `SW wear <state>` on skins and swatches (wear.py). State overlay: group `SW overlay <state>`, its `SW overlay master` value scales it (0 = base wear only).
conventions.metric: Hull units; multiply by metres_per_unit for metres. Nothing in the asset is in metres.
